description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Orders made vest with the Urban Development Authority the lands in Lunupokuna Ward and Kotahena Ward, Colombo D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the vesting of two parcels of land (in Lunupokuna ward and Kotahena ward) with the Urban Development Authority. It contains detailed descriptions of the land boundaries, extents, and survey plans. While it mentions a government minister (Patali Champika Ranawaka) and references a legal authority (Urban Development Authority Law), the core content is about land transfer and property description, making it a Land Gazette according to the classification rules.
